whatIs.title: What is Bogeumjari Loan?
whatIs.description: Bogeumjari Loan is a government-backed fixed-rate mortgage provided by Korea Housing Finance Corporation (HF). It offers more stable rates than variable-rate bank loans, with preferential terms for first-time buyers, newlyweds, and multi-child families.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Enter property price and combined household annual income.
View eligibility, estimated loan limit, and monthly payment.

tips.title: Tips
items: First-time buyers get LTV up to 80% (70% for homes in the capital area or regulated zones) and a higher limit of KRW 420M vs 360M for the general type.
Newlywed type offers a 0.3%p rate discount. Check if your marriage was registered within the last 7 years.
Akkim-e Bogeumjari (online e-contract) is 0.1%p cheaper than u-Bogeumjari and t-Bogeumjari. Homes in regulated zones carry a 0.2%p surcharge.

items.a: Combined household income up to KRW 70M (newlyweds 85M, one minor child 90M, two or more 100M), home price up to KRW 600M, no home or one home to be sold within 3 years, and a credit score of 271 or higher.

Per the November 9, 2026 notice, Akkim-e Bogeumjari rates are 5.00% (10-year) to 5.30% (50-year), up 0.10%p from October. Discounts add up to 1.0%p at most, and homes in regulated zones carry a 0.2%p surcharge. Rates change monthly, so check the HF rate page.

items.q: How does it differ from Didimddol Loan?
items.a: Didimddol requires income up to KRW 60M (first-time buyers and two-child families 70M, newlyweds 85M) and a home up to KRW 500M (newlyweds/two children 600M), but its rate is lower at 2.85-4.15%. Its limit is KRW 200M (first-time 240M, newlyweds/two children 320M). Bogeumjari has broader income criteria and a limit of up to KRW 420M.

items.q: What are the eligibility requirements for first-time buyer (생애최초) type?
items.a: On the application date both spouses must own no home, and neither you nor your spouse may have ever owned a home. Even if you own no home now, any past ownership means you must apply under the general type.

items.q: What is the interest rate for first-time buyer Bogeumjari Loan?
items.a: There is no first-time-buyer rate discount; the same base rate applies (5.20% for 30 years as of November 2026). Applicable discounts such as newlywed (0.3%p), multi-child (0.5-0.7%p) or low-income youth (0.1%p) can lower it by up to 1.0%p, to 4.20% for 30 years. Homes in regulated zones add 0.2%p.

items.q: What is the maximum loan amount for first-time buyer Bogeumjari Loan?
items.a: Up to KRW 420M. LTV is 80%, but 70% for homes in the capital area (Seoul, Incheon, Gyeonggi) or regulated zones. For a KRW 500M home that means up to 400M outside the capital area and 350M inside it, subject also to DTI 60%.
